title: Lively Turtle Helmet
description: Turtle Helmet now has a life!
body: Angelos' # Lively Turtle Helmet # The pack you didn't know you needed. This resource pack brings your Turtle Helmet to life by adding an adorable head and little legs, turning your helmet into a little turtle friend. ### Compatible with Joyful Motions # Media Links Join our Discord server to report bugs and give suggestions, and follow my YouTube channel to see previews of upcoming features and update showcases! [](https://www.youtube.com/@angxlvs) [](https://discord.gg/qMrDaZZCdG) # Credits This resource pack contains modified assets from [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) by FreshLX. Used under their terms. # Requirements This pack requires **Entity Model Features**
